label: Signal
mood: Warm, energetic, direct. Reads urgent without shouting.
note: Tom Ferry runs orange #F26F21 as his second accent. Raw, it is 2.97:1 on white and cannot be text or carry white text. #BB4C0A is that same hue pushed until it clears AA in both directions, so one value does the button and the link.
evidence: accent from Tom Ferry's orange #F26F21, corrected. Warm near-black ink follows finding 3.

bg.role: primary surface, pure white. Do not tint it

bg-2.role: sunken fill, table rows, inset panels. Faintly warm

line.role: hairline and divider on bg, non-text

structure.role: deep burnt orange. Chart bars, structural fills, large headings

ink-2.role: secondary text on bg and bg-2

accent-txt.role: accent used AS text on bg or bg-2. Same value, it clears both

accent-inv.role: accent used AS text on bg-inv
